$comment: engine.services (MOD-033) module-owned balance surface: the §10 service-kind extensibility data is in code, the §26 shared staffing pools and the §54 Public Service Pie benchmark ratios are here. Loaded via internal/engine/services' Load (foundation/data's generic Load[T]), mirroring engine.market's data/market.json and engine.logistics' data/logistics.json precedent of a module-owned data file. GR#15: every ratio/scale below is a placeholder tunable in the M2 Batch; the ONLY figure transcribed from the spec is the police ~2.4 officers per 1,000 (§54) — everything else is a directional placeholder pending the balance pass (see docs/planning/acceptance/engine.services.md AC-5's escalation).

staffingPools.label: Nursing
staffingPools.specRef: §26: elder care and home-care draw from the same staffing pool as hospitals — a nurse shortage is one shortage everywhere

pie.specRef: §54: the default Public Service Pie — per-1,000-population benchmark staffing ratios (police officers ~2.4, teachers per pupil, nurses & GPs, dentists & opticians, firefighters, social workers, refuse crews, council officers). These are default benchmarks, NOT hard requirements: the whole point is the player deviates and feels the consequence (mild at village scale, systemic at city scale).
